commands.label: Add this PC
commands.description: Game PCs: adds a PC running Sunshine to the person's own list (item: its address, as the network found it). It has to answer as Sunshine.

commands.label: Wake it up
commands.description: Game PCs: sends a wake-up signal to one of the person's PCs (item: its ID).

commands.label: End what's running
commands.description: Game PCs: ends the game running on one of the person's PCs (item: its ID).

commands.label: Pair this PC
commands.description: Game PCs: starts pairing one of the person's PCs (item: its ID). The PC's page shows the PIN to type into Sunshine.

commands.label: Stop pairing
commands.description: Game PCs: stops waiting for a PIN (item: the PC's ID).

commands.label: Remove
commands.description: Game PCs: takes a PC off the person's list (item: its ID). The PC keeps this server on its own list until someone removes it there.

groups.title: Who may connect
groups.footer: This has the server connect wherever a person says. It only ever speaks this one protocol. Administrators can always.

rows.label: Who can use it
rows.help: A PC's desktop is outside anything age limits can reach, so Kids and Guest profiles and limited accounts start without this.

groups.title: Reaching browsers away from home
groups.footer: Nothing needed at home. Never forward Sunshine's own ports, and never port 47990.
